summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 1, 2026, announcing the pending opening of its first Canna Cabana store in Peterborough, Ontario at 400 Lansdowne Street East, expected to begin adult-use cannabis sales October 15, 2026, bringing Canadian store count to 233 including 107 in Ontario. The release also discloses a board-approved grant of 352,674 restricted share units to directors under the 2022 omnibus plan, vesting in 12 months, treated as a related-party transaction exempt from MI 61-101 valuation and minority-approval requirements. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated. This is a routine operational and compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
